architecture: One Knowledge Graph · Two Learning Paths
purpose: Scale the six-dimension evidence audit to the 21 semantically reconciled Grade-7 KNTT rows without treating skill identity or roadmap placement as proof of learner evidence.

dimension_definitions.SKILL_MAP: Semantic curriculum-to-skill/family/local mapping; not learner evidence by itself.
dimension_definitions.LEARN_CONTENT: Explicit learner-facing explanation/content that directly teaches the row's semantic target.
dimension_definitions.MICRO_PRACTICE: Short formative practice explicitly aligned to the row.
dimension_definitions.PRACTICE_BANK: Reusable interactive practice evidence; topic/family evidence must not be overstated as exact lesson evidence.
dimension_definitions.WRITTEN_LIBRARY: Canonical Written item with true KNTT placement, not prerequisite overlap.
dimension_definitions.READINESS: Structured independently interpreted readiness evidence; absence means NOT_VERIFIED, not that the learner lacks mastery.

summary.note: Existing-evidence inventory only. Priority labels identify audit candidates, not authoring authorization.

status_semantics.SKILL_MAP: VERIFIED_SEMANTIC means the row's curriculum semantics are closed by reviewed Grade-7 reconciliation; it is not learner-performance evidence.
status_semantics.LEARN_CONTENT: VERIFIED_DIRECT requires all direct targets in learner-facing workspace content. PARTIAL_* means at least one reviewed direct/family/local target is not explicit.
status_semantics.MICRO_PRACTICE: VERIFIED_DIRECT requires explicit Grade-7/shared-Grade-7 Micro evidence for all direct targets. NONE_G7_EXPLICIT means no Grade-7-scoped Micro evidence was found.
status_semantics.PRACTICE_BANK: TOPIC_SKILL_EVIDENCE means the topic Practice manifest contains all direct skills but does not by itself prove exact lesson placement. PARTIAL_* records missing direct or family/local evidence.
status_semantics.WRITTEN_LIBRARY: VERIFIED_KNTT_PLACEMENT requires a canonical Written item's true Grade-7 kntt_placement. Skill overlap alone is not enough.
status_semantics.READINESS: PARTIAL_G7_STRUCTURED means explicit Grade-7-tagged readiness items cover only part of the row. NOT_VERIFIED_STRUCTURED means no explicit Grade-7 structured evidence was found; NONE means no topic readiness asset exists.
